title: QFBench 2.0 per-file data manifest
description: The per-file CHECKSUM manifest. qfbench2_common.manifest.verify_manifest verifies it EXACTLY and in BOTH directions -- manifest->disk (every entry exists, is a plain single-linked readable regular file, and hashes to the recorded digest) and disk->manifest (no unmanifested file inside a covered subtree). Structural validation lives here; the cross-field invariants (path safety, duplicate and NFC/case collisions, node types) are enforced by that module, which is the authority.

coverage.description: Which subtrees this manifest claims to be EXACT over, relative to the unit directory, each covered recursively. "." means the whole unit. When absent, coverage is DERIVED: the first path component of every entry that has one, plus the unit root non-recursively if any entry is a root-level file. The derived form leaves a directory that holds no manifest entry unpoliced -- declare coverage to close that, and declare ["."] to leave no gap. manifest.json is never counted as an unmanifested extra.

path.description: Relative to the unit directory, POSIX separators, NFC-normalized. Absolute paths, '..'/'.' components, backslashes and drive letters are refused: the previous implementation joined this straight onto the unit directory, so an absolute path replaced it outright.
